items.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Dutch Reagan was the sportscaster. My dad, who loved him immensely said he didn’t know anything about sports either.

ctx.x: I started violin when I was six years old. My dad was a saxophone player in Des Moines, Iowa. He traveled around the midwest with the band and he also had the staff band of WHO and this was when Ronald Reagan was the, Dutch Reagan was the sportscaster. My dad, who loved him immensely said he didn’t know anything about sports either. So anyway—
